seed_scheme: seed_i = avalanche_hash(baseSeed + (i+1)*0x9E3779B1), i = run index from 0; every run has its own seed; group = i mod 5 so every group samples the whole seed range
card_play_ai: the page's own aiDraw/aiDiscard (opponent AI) applied to seat 0 with no 'skill' set, i.e. always the best play (same as Hard). Opponents use the Run's own tiers.

policy_notes.baseline: Never buys. Takes the Boss-bounty free pick (price 0) from the first offer in shop order, because the spec says to retain free rewards.
policy_notes.random: Uniform choice among legal actions {buy any affordable offer, reroll, done}; if Regalia slots are full and a Regalia offer is affordable, selling any owned Regalia is also a legal action. Max 6 actions per Court. No reserve.
policy_notes.listed: economic/aggressive/defensive: buy the best-ranked affordable listed offer (ranking = list order; a free Boss-bounty pick goes to the listed offer with the highest list price), keep >= 5 gold after paying unless free; sell an unlisted Regalia if slots are full; reroll once if nothing listed is on offer and 12+ gold would remain.
policy_notes.decrees: insurance: last lap & hand cost>=8; pardon: last lap & cost>=6; redeal: first turn & avg leftover>=7/card; pickpocket: if the 2nd discard lowers best cost; fog: when cost<=6; scout: whenever possible (no effect on this AI).

regalia.name: Court Fool
regalia.text: You’re dealt an extra Joker every round (except against the Usurper).

regalia.name: Twin Crowns
regalia.text: Pairs of J, Q or K count as books for you.

regalia.name: Starlight
regalia.text: ★ cards left in your hand cost nothing.

regalia.name: Low Tide
regalia.text: 3s, 4s and 5s left in your hand cost nothing.

regalia.name: Heavy Purse
regalia.text: J, Q and K left in your hand cost 5 each.

regalia.name: Miser's Vault
regalia.text: A round never costs you more than 25 gold.

regalia.name: Spyglass
regalia.text: You can always see the top card of the deck.

regalia.name: Eavesdropper
regalia.text: See how many unmatched points each opponent holds.

regalia.name: Herald
regalia.text: +5 more gold whenever you go out first.

regalia.name: Early Bird
regalia.text: Go out within your first 3 turns and your going-out gold doubles.

regalia.name: Royal Mint
regalia.text: +1 gold for every ♦ in your groups at round end.

regalia.name: Tax Collector
regalia.text: +1 gold for every 10 points your opponents are caught with.

regalia.name: Interest
regalia.text: +1 gold for every 10 in your Treasury at round end (up to +5).

regalia.name: Second Wind
regalia.text: Once per run, survive bankruptcy with 10 gold. Then it’s used up.

regalia.name: Gambler's Hand
regalia.text: Going-out gold ×3, but what you’re caught with costs 1.5×.

decrees.name: Pickpocket
decrees.text: Before you draw: take the second card down in the discard pile.

decrees.name: Scout
decrees.text: Before you draw: see the top card of the deck.

decrees.name: Redeal
decrees.text: Before you draw: shuffle your hand into the deck and draw a fresh one.

decrees.name: Fog
decrees.text: On your turn: the next player can’t take from the discard pile.

decrees.name: Royal Pardon
decrees.text: This round, your highest-scoring leftover card is free.

4.name: The Miser
4.rule: Nobody may take from the discard pile this round.

8.name: The Jester
8.rule: The wild rank changes after every turn.

11.name: The Usurper
11.rule: Jokers aren’t wild for you. They’re dead cards worth 50.
